groups.name: canJ7
groups.why: shield can J7 (sheet(s) pll): one group, every part on the front under the can (side F), none flippable; LMX2541 PLL/VCO: the can is built around it (34 of the can's passives sit on its pins); the VCXO U2 follows it (row U2 near R13)

templates.why: LMX2541 PLL/VCO: L1-L7 are BLM18AG ferrite beads on its supply pins (filters, not a switching stage); emc_roles hint is a false positive

groups.name: canJ8
groups.why: shield can J8 (sheet(s) mixers, iqmod): one group, every part on the front under the can (side F), none flippable; HMC1097 IQ modulator: main device of J8 (IQ mod sheet); the U21-U27 mixer chain follows by ordered chain rows

templates.why: PMA2-43LN+ LNA gain block: bias inductor, DC blocks and output choke per its datasheet Fig 1
second PMA2-43LN+ gain block, same circuit

groups.name: canJ9
groups.why: shield can J9 (sheet(s) dac_if): one group, every part on the front under the can (side F), none flippable; DAC-output op-amp pair U10/U11: 8 + 8 passives on their local nets (DAC output stage C45-C50, R50-R57) against 6 + 6 on the LT6600 filters U14/U15 (netrows ic_candidates), so U10/U11 are the DAC IF circuit's centre

groups.name: canJ10
groups.why: shield can J10 (sheet(s) dividers): one group, every part on the front under the can (side F), none flippable; HMC705 divider U20: the last stage, the only one whose outputs (C96/C97) leave the can for SMAs J3/J4; U18 and U19 chain back from it

groups.name: canJ11
groups.why: shield can J11 (sheet(s) adc): one group, every part on the front under the can (side F), none flippable; ADS8694 ADC: the can's main device (16 passives; the U28 driver and U30 reference serve it)

groups.name: canJ12
groups.why: shield can J12 (sheet(s) dac): one group, every part on the front under the can (side F), none flippable; LTC2758 dual DAC: the can's main device (27 passives on its local nets)

groups.name: digital
